lines.name: Janamejaya
lines.words: pūror bhāryā kausalyā nāma tasyām asya jajñe janamejayo

lines.name: Prācinvān
lines.words: janamejayaḥ khalv anantāṃ nāmopayeme mādhavīm tasyām asya jajñe prācinvān

lines.name: Saṃyāti
lines.words: prācinvān khalv aśmakīm upayeme tasyām asya jajñe saṃyātiḥ

lines.name: Ahaṃpāti
lines.words: saṃyātiḥ khalu dṛṣadvato duhitaraṃ varāṅgīṃ nāmopayeme tasyām asya jajñe ahaṃpātiḥ

lines.name: Sārvabhauma
lines.words: ahaṃpātis tu khalu kṛtavīryaduhitaram upayeme bhānumatīṃ nāma tasyām asya jajñe sārvabhaumaḥ

lines.name: Jayatsena
lines.words: sārvabhaumaḥ khalu jitvājahāra kaikeyīṃ sunandāṃ nāma tasyām asya jajñe jayatsenaḥ

lines.name: Arācīna
lines.words: jayatsenaḥ khalu vaidarbhīm upayeme suṣuvāṃ nāma tasyām asya jajñe arācīnaḥ

lines.name: Mahābhauma
lines.words: arācīno 'pi vaidarbhīm evāparām upayeme maryādāṃ nāma tasyām asya jajñe mahābhaumaḥ

lines.name: Ayutanāyin
lines.words: mahābhaumaḥ khalu prāsenajitīm upayeme suyajñāṃ nāma tasyām asya jajñe ayutanāyī

lines.name: Akrodhana
lines.words: ayutanāyī khalu pṛthuśravaso duhitaram upayeme bhāsāṃ nāma tasyām asya jajñe akrodhanaḥ

lines.name: Devātithi
lines.words: akrodhanaḥ khalu kāliṅgīṃ karaṇḍuṃ nāmopayeme tasyām asya jajñe devātithiḥ

lines.name: Ṛca
lines.words: devātithiḥ khalu vaidehīm upayeme maryādāṃ nāma tasyām asya jajñe ṛcaḥ

lines.name: Ṛkṣa
lines.words: ṛcaḥ khalv āṅgeyīm upayeme sudevāṃ nāma tasyāṃ putram ajanayad ṛkṣam

lines.name: Matināra
lines.words: ṛkṣaḥ khalu takṣakaduhitaram upayeme jvālāṃ nāma tasyāṃ putraṃ matināraṃ nāmotpādayām āsa

lines.name: Taṃsu
lines.words: taṃ bhartāraṃ varayām āsa tasyāṃ putram ajanayat taṃsuṃ nāma

lines.name: Ilina
lines.words: ilinaṃ janayām āsa kālindyāṃ taṃsur ātmajam

lines.name: Duḥṣanta
lines.words: ilinas tu rathaṃtaryāṃ duḥṣantādyān pañca putrān ajanayat

lines.name: Bharata
lines.words: duḥṣantaḥ khalu viśvāmitraduhitaraṃ śakuntalāṃ nāmopayeme tasyām asya jajñe bharataḥ

lines.name: Bhumanyu
lines.words: bharataḥ khalu kāśeyīm upayeme sārvasenīṃ sunandāṃ nāma tasyām asya jajñe bhumanyuḥ

lines.name: Suhotra
lines.words: bhumanyuḥ khalu dāśārhīm upayeme jayāṃ nāma tasyām asya jajñe suhotraḥ

lines.name: Hastin
lines.words: suhotraḥ khalv ikṣvākukanyām upayeme suvarṇāṃ nāma tasyām asya jajñe hastī

lines.name: Vikuṇṭhana
lines.words: hastī khalu traigartīm upayeme yaśodharāṃ nāma tasyām asya jajñe vikuṇṭhanaḥ

lines.name: Ajamīḍha
lines.words: vikuṇṭhanaḥ khalu dāśārhīm upayeme sudevāṃ nāma tasyām asya jajñe 'jamīḍhaḥ

lines.name: Kuru
lines.words: saṃvaraṇaḥ khalu vaivasvatīṃ tapatīṃ nāmopayeme tasyām asya jajñe kuruḥ

lines.name: Viḍūratha
lines.words: kuruḥ khalu dāśārhīm upayeme śubhāṅgīṃ nāma tasyām asya jajñe viḍūrathaḥ

lines.name: Arugvān
lines.words: viḍūrathas tu māgadhīm upayeme saṃpriyāṃ nāma tasyām asya jajñe 'rugvān

lines.name: Parikṣit
lines.words: arugvān khalu māgadhīm upayeme 'mṛtāṃ nāma tasyām asya jajñe parikṣit

lines.name: Janamejaya
lines.words: tasyām asya janamejayaḥ

lines.name: Śatānīka
lines.words: janamejayāt tu vapuṣṭamāyāṃ dvau putrau śatānīkaḥ

lines.name: Aśvamedhadatta
lines.words: tasyām asya jajñe putro 'śvamedhadattaḥ

lines.name: Śaṃtanu
lines.words: putrān utpādayām āsa devāpiṃ śaṃtanuṃ

lines.name: Vicitravīrya
lines.words: śaṃtanor dvau putrau babhūvatuḥ citrāṅgado vicitravīryaś ca

lines.name: Pāṇḍu
lines.words: sādhv apatyaṃ tasyotpādayeti sa param ity uktvā trīn putrān utpādayām āsa dhṛtarāṣṭraṃ pāṇḍuṃ

lines.name: Yudhiṣṭhira
lines.words: sā tatra putrān utpādayām āsa dharmād yudhiṣṭhiraṃ

lines.name: Prativindhya
lines.words: prativindhyaṃ yudhiṣṭhiraḥ

lines.name: Āyu
lines.words: purūravasa āyuḥ

lines.name: Nahuṣa
lines.words: āyuṣo nahuṣaḥ

lines.name: Yayāti
lines.words: nahuṣasya yayātiḥ

lines.name: Vivasvān
lines.words: aditer vivasvān

lines.name: Manu
lines.words: vivasvato manuḥ
